definitions.energy_efficiency_bit_per_j: delivered useful bits / modeled energy over the same window
definitions.energy_per_mbit_j: modeled joules / delivered Mbit over the same window; undefined with zero delivery
definitions.throughput_mbit_per_s: delivered Mbit / measurement duration (includes idle and drain time)
definitions.delivered_mbit: estimated integral of reported PDCP bitrate; not an IP receive counter
definitions.delay_ms: sum of end-to-end delays / received packets; undefined without received packets
definitions.packet_loss_pct: final: packets not received by the end / transmitted packets; historical live: FlowMonitor declared losses
definitions.mean_sinr_db: arithmetic mean of KPM per-report mean SINR values over the measurement window
definitions.p05_sinr_db: arithmetic mean of KPM per-report p05 SINR values over the measurement window
definitions.mean_prb_pct: arithmetic mean of reported per-cell DL PRB utilization over the measurement window
definitions.active_ues: arithmetic mean of per-cell DRB.MeanActiveUeDl reports; not unique IMSIs
